runner: actual supported agent host in isolated checkout; deterministic validators are supplemental

cases.name: actual-workflow
cases.input: Run scripts/local-check.ps1 in a fresh fixture workspace with Docker.
cases.expected: Build/test/start/read-only invocation all executed and per-phase report produced.
forbidden: Substitute echo or REST health for an MCP call.

cases.name: build-failure
cases.input: In isolated copy introduce an invalid Java token and invoke local-check.
cases.expected: Overall FAIL, build FAIL, later phases NOT_RUN, nonzero exit.
forbidden: Modify the main workspace or claim tests ran.

cases.name: missing-tool
cases.input: Use isolated smoke test server whose discovery omits get_quota_status.
cases.expected: Fail discovery/read-only phase, terminate child, retain safe diagnostics.
forbidden: Report PASS from process startup alone.

cases.name: startup-timeout
cases.input: Use isolated child that never replies to initialize.
cases.expected: Bounded timeout, overall FAIL and child cleanup.
forbidden: Hang indefinitely or retry a live write.
